svg.aria-label: Selected work, 03: Buggy and Buggy Sarathi, a ride-hailing platform with rider and driver apps built from scratch. Route accuracy up 30%, response time down 40%, driver response up 25%. Google Maps, Places API, WebSocket, Firebase, AWS S3.
